title: P2RLN Course Profile
description: Defines a package whose primary entrypoint is a portable course graph.
rules: The manifest MUST contain exactly one primary entrypoint of type course.
The primary entrypoint MUST resolve to a course entity in graph.json.
All children references MUST resolve to graph entities.
The children hierarchy MUST be acyclic.
A lossless processor MUST NOT silently remove unsupported optional profile data.
